title: 蛇没有腿怎么走 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材
style: children's picture book illustration, fine pen lines with light transparent watercolour washes, moss green, warm grey and soft amber

pages.scene: One single snake lying stretched out in one perfectly straight line from its head to the tip of its tail, seen from directly above, its body straight along its whole length and not coiled, looped or curled at any point. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges. The object floats on this flat colour: it casts no shadow and rests on no ground, and there is no darker patch, wash, puddle, base, line or platform of any kind underneath it. There is no sky, no horizon, no clouds and no scenery of any kind behind it: the cream colour is the only thing behind the object, exactly as if the object had been cut out and laid on blank paper.
